reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Line added to cmd/crossplane/core/core.go: return errors.New(\"Crossplane removed support for external secret stores. The --enable-external-secret-stores flag…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: workload-failure

consequence.statement: Crossplane's core command returns an error saying external secret store support was removed, so it likely fails to start when --enable-external-secret-stores is set; the added line alone does not show the exact condition.
consequence.remediation: Remove --enable-external-secret-stores from the Crossplane args and stop relying on external secret stores.

proposed.statement: In v2.0.0 core.go returns an error stating Crossplane removed support for external secret stores, and the --enable-external-secret-stores flag will be removed in a future release.
